[IALC.10.1] **Completeness.** Built `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` against a strong
`ds_*` set that tags and counts, a run of the test corpus must show
**zero** allocations reaching libc except through the tag — i.e. every
byte libds's C code and protobuf-c allocate passed through the layer.
The regex engine is outside the layer ([IALC.3.5]), and the corpus
evaluates no regex, so the check measures nothing of it.
This catches a missed raw `malloc`, a stray `NULL` protobuf allocator,
or an unconverted `strdup`.
